title: Backlog
description: The lessons backlog, plan/lessons-backlog.yaml, imported into this repo's GitHub issues by the toolkit's shared Backlog sync workflow (copied from the toolkit's backlog-seed schema). Items refer to each other by key, a descriptive kebab-case name, never a code.

key.description: Stable descriptive name; the importer uses it to update rather than duplicate.

type.description: outcome: a result the lessons owner agrees. deliverable: part of an outcome. task: part of a deliverable. decision: a question for the lessons owner, resolved by a decision record.

phase.description: The kind of work: videos and slides, new lessons, fixes to lessons, helping people find lessons, companies making them their own, or upkeep of this repo.

done_by.description: tool: an automated, repeatable tool. ai: a person with AI coding assistance; the AI drafts, the person reviews, an automated check must pass. person: a human decision or activity.

blocked_by.description: Keys of items that must be finished first.

decision_record.description: For decision items: path of the decision record that resolves it.

status.description: done: the work is finished; importers close the item as completed. Omitted means open.
